Priority Jewels IPO Opens, Fully Subscribed on Day 1

The Initial Public Offering (IPO) for Priority Jewels opened on March 13, 2024, and was fully subscribed on its first day. Retail investors were reported to be the primary drivers of the strong demand. Grey Market Premium (GMP) data indicated a potential listing gain of approximately 19%.
